name: Refrain Dream
source:
The main character is a graduating high school student. 
On Christmas Eve he confesses his feelings to his childhood friend. She passes him the ring saying that she will come to him when he remembers. In a dream a mysterious girl comes to him saying that he should get the paired ring in order to fulfill his hopes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名即将毕业的高中生。圣诞夜，他向青梅竹马告白。少女将一枚戒指交给他，说等他回想起来后，自己便会来到他身边。梦中，一名神秘少女告诉主人公，只要找到与之成对的另一枚戒指，他的愿望就能实现。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
